note: Jasper County, IN publishes no queryable zoning district service. Its only GIS link is the Schneider Beacon viewer (beacon.schneidercorp.com, AppID 509), a viewer with no public REST endpoint. The City of Rensselaer's zoning map is a PDF (document center id=2445) and its ordinance is a PDF/Google Drive file. DeMotte's zoning is adopted by reference as a paper map. ArcGIS Hub searches for Jasper County zoning returned no Indiana county layer; the Jasper County open data hub found belongs to Jasper County, Missouri. Third-party sites (zoneomics, equatorstudios) do not expose an official service.
